job.question: In the CAJPA sample investment management RFP (Appendix Z, 'Sample Investment Management Request for Proposal'), how many copies of the proposal must be sent?
job.expected_facts: Ten (10) copies of the proposal and correspondence, sent to the pool administrator (shown as 'John Doe, 123 Main Street' in the template).
job.acceptance: Ten/10 copies suffices; template addressee and correspondence wording are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a District of Columbia Retirement Board real-assets consulting RFP, not CAJPA Appendix Z. Its proposal-copy requirement applies to that different solicitation and does not support the requested fact.
quotes: District of Columbia Retirement Board Request for Proposal Real Assets Investment Consulting Services
